evaluation_context.rule: Every visual frame must have an actual decoded timestamp in [clip_start_sec, clip_end_sec). Parent-video frames outside the canonical clip are forbidden.

blind.description: No visual input. Open receives question only; Closed receives question plus deterministic candidate order.

uniform_8.sampling_rule: N=min(budget, max(1, floor(canonical_clip_duration_sec * nominal_fps))). Request equal temporal-bin centres in [clip_start_sec, clip_end_sec); decode the nearest unique real frame constrained to the canonical clip.

uniform_32.sampling_rule: N=min(budget, max(1, floor(canonical_clip_duration_sec * nominal_fps))). Request equal temporal-bin centres in [clip_start_sec, clip_end_sec); decode the nearest unique real frame constrained to the canonical clip.

oracle_leq8.interval_rule: For start < end, take the intersection of GT evidence [video_start_sec, video_end_sec) and canonical clip. Uniformly request up to eight equal-bin centres in that intersection; decode nearest unique real frames constrained to that intersection.
oracle_leq8.point_rule: For start == end, retain the sample provisionally and use one nearest decodable real frame constrained to the canonical clip. Do not discard automatically.
oracle_leq8.invalid_interval_rule: Fail the sample explicitly; never widen beyond canonical clip.

closed_candidate_order.rule: Deterministic SHA256(sample_id) Fisher-Yates permutation of [ground-truth answer] + wrong_answers. This annotation export does not provide an option order.

prompts.open:
You are answering an open-ended question about a video. Use only the provided visual evidence when present. Answer concisely and factually. Do not mention uncertainty unless the evidence truly does not support an answer.

QUESTION:
{question}

Return only the answer text.
